subject: La Jamais Contente
hook: LA JAMAIS CONTENTE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: La Jamais Contente was not a gas-guzzling invention, but an electric vehicle that reached over 100 km/h, highlighting that electric cars were the speed leaders before combustion engines took over.
angle_support: It was a Belgian electric vehicle with a light-alloy torpedo-shaped bodywork and batteries.
After this exploit, the gasoline-fuelled combustion engine would increasingly supplant electric technology for the next century.
title: The 1899 Electric Car That Broke Every Speed Record
description: Before gasoline engines dominated the industry, electric vehicles set the standard for performance. La Jamais Contente proved that battery power could reach historic speeds at the dawn of the automotive age.
narration: LA JAMAIS CONTENTE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture an early, slow, gas-powered relic. It was actually a silent, electric speed machine that proved electricity could dominate the road long before combustion took over. In 1899, this torpedo-shaped vehicle smashed the hundred kilometer per hour barrier. Built from an aluminum alloy called partinium, its dual motors produced sixty-eight horsepower, pushing it to a verified record of over one hundred five kilometers per hour. The true pioneer of high speed was powered by electricity alone.
